cluster._comment: Tier mix per Sec. 5.2.1. Total N=8.

_cluster_fixtures._comment: Named fixtures; `cluster` selects the active mix.

testbed_n2._comment: The physical testbed: two Orin Nanos, N=2, S=2, one boundary. Both are 'low' tier -- Orin Nano is exactly what that tier describes. The 8-node mix no longer describes anything runnable, so predicted-vs-measured needs this fixture.

_dead_logging._note: Never read. run.py always writes per-window JSONL and ignores dump_fields, so this describes behaviour it does not control.

controller_cost._comment: Per-window wall-clock cost of the controller's OWN optimisation, charged to TTLT. The simulator charges Omega for migration and zero for deciding, which is not neutral between schemes: FM enumerates ordered placements with a surrogate evaluation each, every window, while DACI runs one boundary DP with placement frozen. Default OFF so the uncharged arm stays reproducible.
controller_cost._statistic: MEAN, not median. The quantity being accumulated is R x per-window cost over hundreds of windows, so the mean is the correct statistic. It matters for RT, whose distribution is bimodal -- it only searches when triggered -- with a 2.37 ms median against a 30.72 ms mean at N=8.

_provenance.hardware: Jetson Orin Nano 8GB, 25W MAXQ, Cortex-A78AE, taskset -c 0 (the controller runs on one core of N_0)
_provenance.note: Pure computation: no ring, no weights. Same code path the simulator runs, timed on the hardware that would run it.

N8_S5._config: N=8, S=5, L=40 (qwen3-14b), W=20; the initial DP chose S=5, so FM enumerates P(8,5)=6720 placements

N2_S2._config: N=2, S=2, L=28 (llama-3.2-3b), W=20; the testbed. P(2,2)=2, so FM's enumeration is trivial and there is no feasibility gap here.

controller_cost._default_off_note: Left OFF in the committed config so the AFTERC arm stays reproducible. The CTRL30 runs set it True on the command line path; see results/m5a_fixes/ for the charged arm.
